title: XMLDecoder object deserialization (java)
description: Java code builds an XMLDecoder with new XMLDecoder(payload). XMLDecoder instantiates objects and invokes methods named in the XML document, so untrusted XML reaches code execution. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms trust or switches to a schema-validated JAXB unmarshaller.
remediation: Replace XMLDecoder with a schema-validated JAXB unmarshaller. Never feed XMLDecoder data that an external party controls.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the constructor regardless of the input source.
